collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DEPARTURES AND EXILE (DEP-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Leaving and being left: moving huts, short journeys, visitors going home, goodbyes done well and badly, homesickness, and the rare person who sails away for good. Choosing to leave is never a rejection of one's people, and choosing to stay is never a failure.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager gives a tired traveler a corner for the night, and the traveler snores loudly: lie awake and laugh, or sleep outside.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A tired traveler has arrived at dusk, walking along the coast, asking if anyone has a corner to sleep in. (name1) has a corner. Not a big one. The traveler is very grateful, very polite, and, (name1) discovers around midnight, the loudest snorer (he/she) has ever heard in (his/her) life.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) quietly takes a blanket outside and sleeps under the stars. It's a beautiful night. In the morning the traveler is horrified to find (him/her) on the ground. "Was I snoring?" (name1) says, very kindly, that (he/she) just likes stars. The traveler doesn't believe a word of it, and leaves a large bag of dried fruit as an apology.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) lies awake listening. It's an astonishing snore: a rumble, a whistle, and a little pop at the end. By the middle of the night (he/she) is shaking with silent laughter. The traveler leaves before dawn and leaves a beautifully carved spoon by the fire as thanks. (name1) is exhausted all day. It was worth it.
